page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is a high-frequency cloud instance driven by a dedicated x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The server configuration includes 20 physical cores split into 40 virtual CPUs using hyperthreading, paired with 192 GB of system memory (4.8 GB per vCPU). CPU cache resources consist of 32 KB L1 data cache, 1.0 MB L2 cache, and a shared 35 MB L3 cache. Advanced instruction capabilities include AVX-512 VNNI for vector and neural network calculations, alongside standard AES cryptographic hardware support.

The system is built without bundled local NVMe storage, requiring attached network block storage for persistent data. It features a 12 Gbps baseline network bandwidth profile and contains no discrete GPU accelerators. Benchmarking places this instance in the middle tier for compute and memory operations. Performance figures include a PassMark CPU score of 34691.95, a Geekbench multi-core rating of 12045.0, and a multi-core stress-ng metric of 38378.07. Memory throughput reaches 108.89 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 48.09 GB/sec for writes. In application metrics, the instance records 34.78 million operations per second in Redis SET benchmarks and 25.35 GB/sec static web serving throughput.

From a resource density and qualitative cost efficiency perspective, the instance balances high clock speeds with 192 GB of RAM without forcing local storage overhead onto workloads that utilize external block storage. This resource profile caters to compute-bound applications that require steady per-core performance. Primary workload fits include enterprise database management systems, high-traffic web serving, software build compilation, lightweight AI model inference, and continuous integration pipelines.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg6.10xlarge is a dedicated high-frequency server powered by an Intel Xeon 8269CY x86_64 processor clocked at 3.1 GHz. It features 20 physical cores and 40 vCPUs, backed by 192 GB of system RAM, offering 4.8 GB per core. The processor incorporates 35 MB of L3 cache alongside AVX-512 VNNI instruction support for vector processing. The instance lacks local disk storage and discrete GPUs, relying on remote block storage and providing a baseline network throughput of 12 Gbps. Benchmark evaluations place the server in the middle performance quartile across standard compute and memory bandwidth suites, achieving a PassMark CPU score of 34691.95 and Redis SET throughput of 34.78 million operations per second. With its balance of high clock speeds and substantial RAM allocation, the server is well suited for relational database operations, software compilation, web serving, and general enterprise data processing workloads.
